findings.highlight: it’s completely isolated during the winter
findings.evidenceJa: 冬場は閑古鳥が鳴くお正月の商店街だ
findings.governingReading: in winter it is a New Year shopping street where only the cuckoo of desolation cries
findings.explanation: The comic comparison that characterizes the deserted rooftop disappears.

findings.highlight: I won’t be able to keep my sanity
findings.evidenceJa: まっとうな思考が保てない
findings.governingReading: I cannot maintain a sound train of thought
findings.explanation: Shirou’s romantic distraction is inflated into loss of sanity.

findings.highlight: my face from blushing
findings.evidenceJa: 赤くなりそうな頬
findings.governingReading: my cheeks from turning red
findings.explanation: The specific image of his cheeks reddening becomes his whole face blushing.

findings.highlight: I know it’s nothing now
findings.evidenceJa: そんなんでいまさら済まされないけど
findings.governingReading: I know that does not make up for it now
findings.explanation: Rin’s admission that the Command Spell cannot settle her responsibility becomes an opaque claim that it is “nothing.”

findings.highlight: My thought process stops
findings.evidenceJa: 浮ついていた意識が止まる
findings.governingReading: My fluttering attention comes to an abrupt stop
findings.explanation: The sudden collapse of Shirou’s excited self-consciousness into seriousness is flattened into generic thought stoppage.

findings.highlight: It’s my responsibility for letting him do as he pleases
findings.evidenceJa: 自由行動をさせた[ruby text=わたし char=3]マスターの責任
findings.governingReading: the responsibility of the Master—of me—who let him act freely
findings.explanation: The written Master/self double reading that makes Rin personally claim institutional responsibility disappears.

findings.highlight: I like that fact less than the fact that Archer attacked me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺はそっちの方が気にくわない
findings.governingReading: That bothers me more than Archer having attacked me
findings.explanation: The English produces an unnatural inverted comparison at a key moment of Shirou’s concern for Rin.

findings.highlight: he decided to kill you
findings.evidenceJa: ここで切り捨てた方がいいって判断した
findings.governingReading: he decided it would be better to cut you loose here
findings.explanation: An instrumental decision to discard Shirou is narrowed into an explicit decision to kill him, making Rin’s report more categorical than the source.

findings.highlight: I almost fell for Caster’s trap
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターの手に落ちかけた
findings.governingReading: I nearly fell into Caster’s hands
findings.explanation: Near capture and control by Caster becomes merely falling for a trap.

findings.highlight: what are we doing
findings.evidenceJa: 我々は何者なのか
findings.governingReading: what kind of people are we
findings.explanation: Shirou’s mock-grand question about their identity as truants becomes a literal question about their activity.

findings.highlight: I think it won’t take you five minutes
findings.evidenceJa: 五分もあれば充分じゃないかしら
findings.governingReading: Surely five minutes is plenty
findings.explanation: Rin’s brazen claim that the allotted time is sufficient becomes a prediction about Shirou’s travel time.

findings.highlight: the demonic request made by Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の悪魔めいた提案
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka’s devilish proposal
findings.explanation: Rin’s conspiratorial proposal becomes a one-sided request.

findings.highlight: My father
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=オヤジ char=2]切嗣
findings.governingReading: Kiritsugu—the old man
findings.explanation: The named source and familiar address are reduced to a generic family role.

findings.highlight: Your body was already too mature
findings.evidenceJa: もう二次成長期あとでしょ
findings.governingReading: you were already past your second growth phase
findings.explanation: A specific developmental threshold for bodily alteration becomes vague maturity.

findings.highlight: this is her part of her as a magus
findings.evidenceJa: それが魔術師として一人前である遠坂らしさ
findings.governingReading: that is characteristic of Tohsaka as a fully fledged magus
findings.explanation: The sentence is grammatically broken and loses the qualification that Rin is fully fledged.

findings.highlight: implant it bit by bit from the time we’re born
findings.evidenceJa: 子供の頃から少しずつ移植していく
findings.governingReading: implant it little by little from childhood
findings.explanation: The stated start in childhood is shifted to birth.

findings.highlight: Why are you asking me?
findings.evidenceJa: なんでそこに俺が出て来るんだ？
findings.governingReading: Why am I being brought into this?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s confusion at Rin equating their lives becomes confusion about being asked a question.

findings.highlight: There is a difference in how much we put on the line, but it just means how much risk we’re willing to take
findings.evidenceJa: 秤には個人差があるけど、要はその秤をどれほど傾けられるか
findings.governingReading: The scales differ from person to person; what matters is how far one can tip those scales
findings.explanation: Rin’s sustained image of life weighed on personal scales is replaced by generic willingness to take risk.

findings.highlight: how we feel when we fail
findings.evidenceJa: 赤点をとる俺たちの気持ち
findings.governingReading: how those of us who get failing grades feel
findings.explanation: The school-grade mechanism connecting Rin’s perfect scores to Shirou’s magical failures is generalized.

findings.highlight: the training is hard, but it’s not harsh
findings.evidenceJa: 教えは厳しかったけど、辛くはなかった
findings.governingReading: the teaching was strict, but it was not painful
findings.explanation: The English uses near-synonyms in reversed order and loses Rin’s central distinction between objective severity and subjective suffering.

findings.highlight: harsh nor severe
findings.evidenceJa: 辛いとも厳しいとも感じなかった
findings.governingReading: painful or severe
findings.explanation: Two different dimensions are rendered as near-synonyms, obscuring why Shirou resembles Rin only partially.

findings.highlight: I want to be like Kiritsugu someday
findings.evidenceJa: いつか切嗣のような人間になる
findings.governingReading: Someday, I would become a person like Kiritsugu
findings.explanation: A stated formative resolve is softened into present desire.

findings.highlight: came to where you are today with your own skill
findings.evidenceJa: 独学でここまできた
findings.governingReading: came this far through self-study
findings.explanation: Rin praises Shirou for teaching himself; the English instead praises an undefined personal skill.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka tells me to be proud
findings.evidenceJa: 胸を張って、遠坂はそう言った
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka said it with her chest proudly raised
findings.explanation: Rin’s proud posture and personal delight are reassigned as an instruction for Shirou to display pride.

findings.highlight: put magical energy into any container
findings.evidenceJa: 色んな器に移し替えられて
findings.governingReading: transfer magical energy into various vessels
findings.explanation: A varied range of vessels is made unlimited.

findings.highlight: holds out her left arm
findings.evidenceJa: 左手を突き出してくる
findings.governingReading: holds out her left hand
findings.explanation: The location of Rin’s displayed crest shifts from hand to the broader arm.

findings.highlight: We cannot create anything special with just magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力だけで神秘は起こせない
findings.governingReading: Magical energy alone cannot bring about Mystery
findings.explanation: A Fate-specific metaphysical claim is reduced to the vague phrase “anything special.”

findings.highlight: I can store things other than magical energy as well
findings.evidenceJa: 移し替えられるのは魔力だけじゃない
findings.governingReading: magical energy is not the only thing I can transfer
findings.explanation: Rin’s broader transfer capability is changed into broader storage capability, altering the function of her Conversion.

findings.highlight: once they succeed
findings.evidenceJa: 後継ぎになったら
findings.governingReading: once they become the heir
findings.explanation: Inheriting the Tohsaka magecraft line is mistranslated as achieving success.

findings.highlight: rather foolish
findings.evidenceJa: 根はドジな方
findings.governingReading: something of a klutz at heart
findings.explanation: Shirou’s affectionate recognition of Rin’s hidden clumsiness becomes a judgment that she is unintelligent.
